app.name: Hunar
app.tagline: Recognition of Prior Learning for domestic electricians
header.queuedAria: {n} changes waiting to sync. Open the sync queue.
banner.rejected: The server refused a queued change ({kind}): {error}
banner.rejectedHelp: Changes queued after it are waiting. Retry it, or discard this one change.
common.sampleTitle: Synthetic sample for demonstration, not a real worker
common.offlineCopy: You are offline. Showing the copy saved on this device.
common.needsConnection: This needs a connection to the server.
common.notFound: Not found on this device, and it could not be loaded from the server.
common.presenceOnly: The photo check only looks at whether PPE and tools are visible. It does NOT judge the quality of the work.
home.intro: Hunar helps assess electricians who learned on the job. The tool suggests; a qualified assessor makes every decision.
home.assessorHint: Choose an assessment below to score it.
declare.title: New worker declaration
declare.codeHint: Use a code such as W-0421. Never enter the worker's real name, phone number or Aadhaar number.
declare.codeLooksLikeName: This looks like a person's name. Please use a code instead.
declare.codeRequired: Enter a worker code (up to 32 characters).
declare.textLabel: Declaration: the worker's work experience in their own words
declare.textHint: Hindi, English or Hinglish. For example: how many years, what kind of wiring, which tools, which safety steps.
voice.recording: Recording… Let the worker describe their work. Stops by itself after 3 minutes.
voice.note: Speech to text gives a draft with mistakes, especially in Hindi. The audio is not stored.
voice.unsupported: This browser cannot record here (it needs a secure https or localhost page). Please type instead.
voice.offline: Voice input needs a connection to the server. Please type instead; nothing is lost.
voice.notInstalled: Voice input is not installed on this server. Please type instead.
voice.micDenied: Microphone access was refused. Allow it in the browser, or type instead.
voice.empty: No speech was recognised. Try again closer to the microphone, or type instead.
voice.readBack: I read the text back to the worker and corrected the mistakes.
voice.readBackRequired: Please read the transcript back to the worker and tick the box before saving.
declare.tooShort: Please write at least a few words.
assess.frozen: Signed off. This assessment can no longer be changed.
mapping.title: Declaration and pack suggestions
mapping.savedOffline: Your declaration is saved and will be matched to qualification packs when the device is online.
mapping.waiting: The declaration is on the server; loading the matches…
mapping.suggestionOnly: Suggestion only — the assessor confirms the pack
mapping.scoreExplain: Scores are text similarity (0 to 1) between the declaration and the official performance criteria. They do not measure skill.
mapping.gaps: Skill gaps: core criteria with no match ({n})
mapping.gapsHint: Not mentioned in the declaration. The practical tasks can still show these skills.
mapping.otherTrade: Pack suggestions compare the declaration with electrical qualifications only. This is a {trade} assessment, so under Scoring you confirm the official {trade} qualification file.
tasks.title: Practical tasks
tasks.intro: Record what the assessor observed. Each answer and photo is saved on this device first.
tasks.consent: Written consent obtained from everyone in the photo
tasks.consentNeeded: Tick the consent box before saving.
tasks.localOnly: This photo stays on this device only until it syncs. Faces are blurred on the server before the photo is stored; the copy on this device is then deleted.
tasks.duplicate: This photo looks like evidence already submitted for another worker — please check
tasks.detectorUnavailable: Photo check not available yet (model not trained)
tasks.nothingDetected: No PPE or tools detected in this photo
tasks.previewAlt: Preview of the photo to be saved
score.title: Assessor scoring
score.packHint: The top suggestion is selected. Choosing another pack needs a reason.
score.packHintTrade: This trade has one official qualification file. Confirm it to start scoring.
score.reasonRequired: A reason is required when you choose a pack other than the top suggestion.
score.reasonNoMapping: The declaration has not been matched yet, so please give a reason for your choice.
score.prescoresAt: Pre scores computed by the server {time}.
score.prescoresMissing: Pre scores are not on this device yet. Connect to the server to load them.
score.prescoresStale: {n} checklist or photo changes are waiting to sync, so these pre scores may be out of date. Accept is turned off until they sync; you can still override.
score.noSuggestion: No suggestion. Score this criterion yourself (override).
score.conflict: Conflict: the checklist and the photos disagree. Please check before deciding.
score.descriptorsEnglish: Descriptors are in English as written in the rubric.
score.overrideReason: Reason for the override (at least 5 characters)
score.decisionPendingAccept: Accepted the suggestion (level fixed when it syncs)
score.criticalNote: Safety criterion: below level 2 blocks a positive recommendation.
score.tradePack: The official qualification file for this trade
profile.title: Competency profile
profile.passMark: Pass mark {p} (default, from the official qualification file)
profile.criticalExplain: Any failed safety (critical) criterion blocks a positive recommendation, whatever the overall score.
profile.noCritical: No critical safety criterion is below competent.
profile.rec.incomplete: Incomplete: some criteria still need an assessor decision.
profile.rec.not_yet_competent: The tool suggests: not yet competent.
profile.rec.recommend_for_certification: The tool suggests: meets the pass mark and all safety criteria. The assessor decides whether to recommend certification.
profile.stale: {n} changes for this assessment are waiting to sync; this profile may be out of date.
profile.missing: The profile is computed by the server. Connect to load it.
profile.signoffOnline: Sign-off needs a connection to the server: it is final and is written straight to the audit log.
profile.signoffNeedsPack: Confirm the qualification pack before signing off.
profile.signoffNeedsAll: Score all criteria before signing off.
profile.signoffNeedsSync: Sync the queued changes for this assessment before signing off.
profile.agree: I agree with the tool's recommendation
profile.disagree: I disagree and record my own outcome
profile.commentRequired: Explain why you disagree (at least 5 characters).
profile.agreed: The assessor agreed with the tool.
profile.disagreed: The assessor disagreed with the tool.
admin.title: Audit log
admin.note: Each entry stores the hash of the previous one, so changing any past entry breaks the chain.
admin.subject: Filter by subject (assessment or worker id)
admin.verifyOk: Chain OK: {n} entries checked. Head hash {head}…
admin.verifyBad: Chain broken: the first bad entry is #{seq} ({n} entries checked).
admin.col.subject: Subject
rater.title: Rater mode: consistency study
rater.intro: Score each photo against one criterion with a level from 0 to 3. The ratings measure how consistently assessors score, with and without the tool's help.
rater.weekApart: Sessions of the two conditions (unassisted and assisted) should be at least one week apart, so that you do not remember the items.
rater.assisted: Assisted: with level descriptors and the tool's pre score
rater.noItems: No study items are available. Real study items have not been loaded yet; tick “Include sample items” to try the demo.
rater.alreadyDone: This session is already complete. Use a new session number to rate again.
rater.noBack: Ratings are final: you cannot go back to earlier items.
rater.noSuggestion: The tool has no suggested level for this item.
rater.pendingUpload: {n} ratings are saved on this device and will upload when online.
rater.failed: {n} ratings were refused by the server: {msg}
rater.needOnline: Loading the items needs a connection to the server.
queue.title: Sync queue
queue.explain: Changes are saved on this device first and sent to the server in order (oldest first) when online.
queue.empty: Nothing waiting. All changes are on the server.
common.noNetwork: No internet connection. Please try again when you are online.
common.offlineFriendly: You are offline. This part of Hunar needs the internet. Nothing is lost; try again when you are connected.
i18n.incomplete: Not all text is translated into {lang} yet. The rest is shown in English.
i18n.machine: Machine-translated, not yet checked by a native speaker.
lang.deviceOnly: The language is saved on this device.
trade.permitNote: This job needs a worker with a State electrical permit (CEA Safety Regulations 2023, reg. 31). Only replacing lamps, fans, fuses, switches, fittings or appliances up to 250 V without changing the wiring is exempt.
onb.customer: I want to hire a worker
onb.quizNext: Right after you create your account, you take a short quiz for your trade ({trade}): {min} to {max} questions. Every worker takes it. There is no pass or fail. Read each question: a quiz rushed through does not count.
intro.w1.title: Start with a short quiz
intro.w1.body: Every worker answers a few short questions about their trade, right after creating the account. It is not an exam and not a certificate.
intro.w2.title: Get your skills checked
intro.w2.body: Ask for a practical assessment. An assessor watches you work and decides.
intro.w3.title: Get work
intro.w3.body: Customers near you can find you and book you. Your phone number is shared only after you accept.
intro.c1.title: Find a worker near you
intro.c1.body: Electricians, plumbers and carpenters. Search by trade and PIN code.
intro.c2.title: See what was checked
intro.c2.body: Badges say what an assessor or an admin checked, and when. They are not government certificates.
intro.c3.title: Book and call
intro.c3.body: Send a request. When the worker accepts, you both see each other's phone number.
consent.title: Your data, your choice
consent.intro: Hunar asks for each use of your data separately. You can change the optional ones at any time in Privacy.
consent.needAll: Tick the required items and the age box to continue.
consent.p.account.title: Your account
consent.p.account.why: to let you log in and to tell the other person in a booking who you are
consent.p.account.data: phone number, display name, preferred language, PIN (stored only as a salted hash)
consent.p.assessment.title: Skill quiz and assessment
consent.p.assessment.why: to estimate your skills with a quiz right after you register, and to let an assessor review them
consent.p.assessment.data: quiz answers and answer times, your work declaration, practical assessment records, task photos (faces blurred before storage)
consent.p.assessment.withdraw: erases your account and your quiz answers (every worker takes the quiz); assessor records already signed off are kept only as the signed-off result
consent.p.profile_display.title: Show my profile to customers
consent.p.profile_display.why: to show your profile to customers who search for a worker
consent.p.profile_display.data: display name, trade, years of experience, district and PIN code, languages, assessor-verified result and its date, booking ratings
consent.p.contact_share.title: Share my phone number after a booking is accepted
consent.p.contact_share.why: to share your phone number with the other person only after a booking is accepted
consent.p.contact_share.withdraw: erases your account (bookings need a way to contact each other)
auth.phoneInvalid: Enter a 10-digit mobile number that starts with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
pin.ruleDigits: The PIN must be 4 to 6 digits.
pin.ruleRepeat: Do not use one digit again and again (like 1111).
pin.ruleSequence: Do not use a sequence (like 1234 or 4321).
pin.rulePhoneEnd: Do not use the last digits of your mobile number.
reg.name: Your name
reg.nameHint: A first name or nickname is enough. The other person sees it in a booking.
reg.pinRules: Not one digit repeated, not a sequence like 1234, not the end of your mobile number.
reg.pinMismatch: The two PINs are not the same.
reg.pinRemember: Remember your PIN. You need it to log in.
reg.sendCode: Send me a code by SMS
reg.exists: This mobile number already has an account.
reg.createAndQuiz: Create account and start the quiz
otp.title: Enter the code
otp.sentTo: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to
login.title: Log in
login.staffNote: For facilitators, assessors and admins. Staff accounts are made by an admin.
login.wrong: The mobile number or PIN is wrong. Please try again.
login.locked: Too many wrong PINs. Wait 15 minutes, or ask an admin to reset your PIN.
login.expired: Your login has ended. Please log in again.
login.queuedKept: Changes saved on this device: {n}. They are sent after a staff login.
login.askAdmin: Ask an admin or your facilitator to reset your PIN.
reset.title: Reset your PIN
reset.logsOut: A new PIN logs you out on every device.
reset.done: Your PIN was changed. Log in with the new PIN.
settings.title: Settings
settings.logoutNote: Logging out removes your login from this device.
settings.queuedOnLogout: Changes not sent yet: {n}. They stay on this device and are sent after the next staff login.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Each use of your data is listed here. Turn the optional ones on or off at any time.
privacy.requiredOn: On. Needed to use Hunar. To stop it, erase your account below.
privacy.eraseExplain: Your phone number, name, PIN, profile and quiz answers are deleted, and open bookings are cancelled. Practical assessments already signed off by an assessor are kept only as the signed-off result. This cannot be undone.
privacy.requiredOff: Off. Workers need this to use Hunar: turn it on to take the quiz.
badge.skillExplain: Practical skills checked by an assessor on {date} against {title}. Not a government certificate.
badge.skillExplainNoQp: Practical skills checked by an assessor on {date}. Not a government certificate.
badge.permitExplain: An admin saw this worker's State electrical permit document ({state}) on {date}. Hunar does not issue permits.
badge.permitSelfExplain: The worker says they have a State electrical permit ({state}). Nobody has checked it yet.
badge.none: Nothing checked yet. This worker has not had a practical assessment on Hunar.
quiz.title: Skill quiz
quiz.intro: Answer {min} to {max} short questions about your trade. The questions adjust to your answers.
quiz.dontGuess: If you do not know an answer, press “Don't know”. Do not guess.
quiz.notCertificate: This is a self-check for you. It is not an exam and not a certificate. Customers never see it.
quiz.needConsent: The quiz needs your agreement to “Skill quiz and assessment”. What it covers:
quiz.noBack: You cannot go back to earlier questions.
quiz.rapid: That was very quick. Please read each question fully before answering. If more than half of the answers are this quick, the quiz does not count.
quiz.trMissing: Not yet in {lang}; shown in Hindi
quiz.resultLine: You would likely answer about {lo}–{hi}% of our questions correctly.
quiz.rangeExplain: A short quiz cannot give one exact number, so the bar shows a range. The line marks the middle.
quiz.reviseNone: No topic stood out. Keep practising!
quiz.note: Self-check score, not a certificate. It shows what you know about the topics in our questions, not how well you work. Only a practical assessment signed off by an assessor can give you a badge.
quiz.bankDraft: Question bank version {v}: DRAFT, not yet reviewed by an expert assessor or ITI instructor.
quiz.uncalibrated: Question difficulties are first estimates, not yet adjusted from real answers.
quiz.reviewIntro: Learn from each question. The right answer is marked.
quiz.requiredFirst: Every worker takes this quiz first.
quiz.requiredWhy: When you finish it, you can fill in your profile, get bookings and ask for a practical assessment. There is no pass or fail, but a quiz rushed through does not count.
quiz.welcomeFirst: Your account is ready, {name}. Now the quiz: choose an answer, or press “Don't know”.
quiz.notCountedBody: {n} of {total} answers came too quickly to have been read. At least {pct}% must be read properly. Please take the quiz again and read each question before you answer.
quiz.lastNotCounted: Your last quiz did not count: too many answers were too quick. Please take it again and read each question.
wprofile.title: My profile
wprofile.intro: Fill in your profile so customers can find you and an assessor knows your trade.
wprofile.hidden: Customers cannot see your profile, because “Show my profile to customers” is off.
wprofile.previewNote: Customers never see your phone number here, your quiz results or your full PIN code.
wprofile.consentFirst: Customers see your profile only if you turn on “Show my profile to customers” in Privacy.
wprofile.tradeResetsPermit: If you change your trade, the permit check is removed.
wprofile.pincodeHint: Customers see only the first 3 digits of your PIN code.
wprofile.bioHint: {n} letters left. Do not write your phone number.
wprofile.permitHave: I have a State electrical permit
wprofile.permitHint: An admin checks the document before customers can book you for work that needs a permit.
wprofile.permitChecked: An admin checked your permit document ({state}) on {date}.
wprofile.quizFirst: First finish the quiz for this trade ({trade}).
profile.welcome: Quiz done, {name}! Now fill in your profile.
profile.nosPassMark: Each NOS also needs {p} (from the official qualification file)
assess.title: Get your skills checked
assess.explain: Ask for a practical assessment. An assessor meets you, watches you do a few real tasks and decides. If the assessor's result is positive, your profile shows a badge with the date. It is not a government certificate.
assess.quizContext: The assessor sees your quiz results only as background. They do not decide anything.
assess.openHelp: An assessor will contact you to fix a time and place.
assess.startedHelp: An assessor has started your practical assessment.
assess.needConsent: To ask for an assessment, turn on “Skill quiz and assessment” in Privacy.
assess.needProfile: First fill in your profile (trade and PIN code).
assess.alreadyOpen: You already have a request waiting. You can send a new one after an assessor has picked it up.
assess.declarationHint: In your own words: how many years, what kind of work, which tools, which safety steps. Type or speak.
assess.tooShort: Please write a little more (at least 10 letters).
assess.checkedText: I read the text and corrected the mistakes.
assess.checkTextFirst: Speech to text makes mistakes. Please read the text, correct it and tick the box.
assess.dateHint: The assessor confirms the date with you.
assess.principle: AI suggests, the assessor decides. There is no result without an assessor.
assess.notForTrade: Practical assessments are not available for {trade} work yet: its practical tasks have not been written. You can still take the quiz, and customers can still find and book you.
voice.recordingSelf: Recording… Talk about your work. It stops by itself after 3 minutes.
find.title: Find a worker
find.pincodeHint: Workers in your area are shown first.
find.badgesNote: Badges say what was checked, by whom and when. They are not government certificates.
find.none: No workers found. Try another PIN code or turn off a filter.
book.title: Book this worker
book.loginFirst: To book, create a free account or log in.
book.customersOnly: Only customer accounts can book a worker.
book.needsPermit: Needs a State permit; this worker's permit document was checked
book.needsPermitBlocked: Needs a checked State permit. Not available with this worker.
book.describeHint: For example: the kitchen fan makes a noise. Do not write your phone number here.
book.dateInvalid: Choose today or a later date.
book.phoneNote: Your phone number is shared with the worker only after they accept.
booking.title: Bookings
booking.sent: Request sent. The worker will accept or decline.
booking.phoneAfterAccept: Phone numbers are shown after the worker accepts.
booking.emptyWorker: No bookings yet. Customers can book you when your profile is visible.
booking.emptyCustomer: No bookings yet. Find a worker to book.
requests.title: Assessment requests
requests.intro: Workers who asked for a practical assessment. Start one to open the usual assessor screens.
requests.quizContextOnly: The worker's own self-check quiz. Context only: it is not evidence and does not change any score.
requests.noQuiz: No self-check quiz yet (or the worker has not allowed it to be shared).
requests.notCounted: Quizzes that did not count (answered too quickly): {n}
requests.notForTrade: This trade has no practical tasks yet, so it cannot be assessed here.
permits.title: Worker permits
permits.intro: Mark a permit as checked only after you have seen the worker's original State electrical permit document.
permits.onlyVisible: All workers are listed, including those whose profile is hidden from customers. Phone numbers stay masked.
permits.seen: I have seen the original permit document.
